name: Happy Happy Choco-Chip Cookies
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, CHOCO CHIPS (8%) [SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE FAT (HYDROGENATED OILS), COCOA SOLIDS, DEXTROSE, EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN (SOYA LECITHIN) AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (VANILLA)], COCOA SOLIDS (2%), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS [503 (ii), 500 (ii)], IODISED SALT AND EMULSIFIER OF VEGETABLE ORIGIN (472e). CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL FOOD COLOUR (150d) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES - CHOCOLATE). CONTAINS: WHEAT, SOY
